description.zh: 是否全部删除资源标签，只针对TagKey为空时有效。默认是false。
description.en: Remove all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey is empty. Default value: false.
Resource type. Set this parameter to vvpinstance.
Array of tag keys. Maximum: 20 items.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun foasconsole untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type vvpinstance --all false --resource-id f-cn-tgy67 --tag-key test --api-version 2021-10-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun foasconsole UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'f-cn-tgy67' --TagKey.1 test --ResourceType vvpinstance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
